content_sections.heading: About Amrita
content_sections.text: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham runs several campuses, and its Kochi Campus has posted this requirement on the jobs page of its website. The job category is listed as Teaching.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice does not name a department or give a category-wise break-up. Its qualification and expertise areas relate to Computer Science and allied fields.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Candidates with a First Class Master's degree (MCA / M.Sc. Computer Science / M.Tech. or equivalent) and qualification in UGC-NET will also be considered, subject to applicable UGC regulations and institutional norms. The notice does not state any experience requirement. The candidate should have expertise in core Computer Science subjects and emerging technologies, particularly: Artificial Intelligence Explainable AI (XAI) Generative AI Large Language Models (LLMs) Cybersecurity and Digital Forensics Edge AI and Internet of Things (IoT) Big Data Analytics

rows.qualification: Ph.D. in Computer Science / Computer Applications / Information Technology or a relevant discipline.

content_sections.heading: Amrita Assistant Professor Job Description
content_sections.text: Teaching undergraduate and postgraduate courses. Developing course materials. Conducting laboratory sessions. Mentoring students and guiding academic projects. Contributing to research activities. Publishing research papers in reputed journals and conferences. Participating in funded research projects and promoting interdisciplinary research collaborations. Contributing to curriculum development, academic administration, accreditation activities and other institutional initiatives.

faq.question: Q1. How many Assistant Professor vacancies are there at Amrita Kochi?
faq.answer: The notice states 5 vacancies for Assistant Professor at the Kochi Campus of Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Amrita Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: The last date to apply is 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Amrita Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: A Ph.D. in Computer Science / Computer Applications / Information Technology or a relevant discipline is required. A First Class Master's degree (MCA / M.Sc. Computer Science / M.Tech. or equivalent) with UGC-NET qualification will also be considered, subject to applicable UGC regulations and institutional norms.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the Amrita Kochi Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: Apply through the Apply Online link on the Amrita jobs page for Assistant Professor @ Kochi. The notice gives [email protected] for further details.

faq.question: Q5. Where is the Amrita Assistant Professor post located?
faq.answer: The post is at the Kochi Campus in Kochi, Kerala.

faq.question: Q6. What will an Amrita Assistant Professor be expected to do?
faq.answer: Duties include teaching undergraduate and postgraduate courses, developing course materials, conducting laboratory sessions, mentoring students, guiding projects and contributing to research.

faq.question: Q7. Which technical areas does Amrita expect expertise in?
faq.answer: The notice names core Computer Science subjects, AI, Explainable AI, Generative AI, Large Language Models, Cybersecurity and Digital Forensics, Edge AI and IoT, and Big Data Analytics.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates without a Ph.D. apply?
faq.answer: Candidates with a First Class Master's degree (MCA / M.Sc. Computer Science / M.Tech. or equivalent) and UGC-NET qualification will also be considered, subject to applicable UGC regulations and institutional norms.
